description: Curated same-token construction stress panel for a fixed first-layer pre-RoPE QK1 response group. Nine strata, eight prompt templates each, selected occurrence of token ID 355 (as) or 523 (so). Compare identity-start response group and one rank-ten Haar control at 25% and full deletion. The reduced cut and groups predate these prompts. No answer-level task competence is asserted; construction labels are designed for validation. KL is measured after the selected key and removed pre-projection head energy recorded for dose analysis.
